Specific safeguards: Use three balanced areas joined into one natural scene: a meadow with visibly different living species; a clearly separated museum-style dodo vignette representing extinction; a learner carefully comparing a beetle specimen with a field guide and magnifier representing scientific discovery work. At most large labels "Vielfalt", "Aussterben", "Entdecken". Do not label the beetle as a confirmed new species or imply that a local first sighting proves novelty.
